column1: # Cases for scripts/statusline.sh, run by run-statusline-cases.sh.
# Cases run with NO_COLOR=1, so the expectation is the layout, not escape bytes.
# @NOW+N@ / @NOW-N@ become epoch seconds N seconds from now. __EMPTY__ expects
# no output at all. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Every field in this JSON is allowed to be absent or null, so most cases here are
# absence cases. Add one whenever you add a segment, and keep the pair that proves
# 0% is rendered rather than treated as missing.
# Countdown offsets sit mid-minute (6450, not 6420) on purpose. The harness fixes
# the epoch a moment before the script reads its own clock, so an offset landing
# exactly on a minute boundary renders one minute lower about half the time.
